stem:
Esha whirls an eraser on a thread so the eraser moves on a circular path. She also rolls a marble along a winding, curving track that is not a circle, and pushes a toy car straight across the floor.

Which motion is circular?

options.text: The marble on the winding track, because its path is not a straight line.
The eraser on the thread, because its path is circular.
The toy car on the floor, because it keeps moving while she pushes.
Both the eraser and the marble, because neither path is a straight line.

teacher.key_rationale: Circular motion means motion on a circular path. A winding non-circular curve is not circular; straight motion is not circular; grouping every non-straight path with circular motion overextends the idea.
